comparison.objective: Retain a housing, rotate and lock a rollover fixture, then fit a wear pad; candidate registers proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential loading, crossbar retention, fixture rotation, bolt insertion, and pad fitting versus screwdriver work and precise sensor translation.
comparison.success_condition: Housing, bar, rotation, bolt, and pad must satisfy staged pose thresholds without unsafe sequencing; candidate needs two secured sensed endpoints.
comparison.reason: The fixture sequence tests retention and insertion rather than calibration. Candidate still lacks exact switch-mount geometry, torque, and drift tolerances.
